channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Willie Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Willie Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Willie Green
item.description:
Pelicans executive vice president of basketball operations Joe Dumars said in a statement.

“I have the utmost respect for Willie Green, and I'm sincerely appreciative of his contributions to the Pelicans organization and the New Orleans community. We wish him and his family all the best in the future.”

Joe Dumars on Willie Green, Nov 15, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars, Willie Green
item.description:
Benson:

“I really like Willie Green, but I hired Joe Dumars to assess our basketball operation. And that’s what he is doing. He is assessing Willie and all the players. He and I spent the entire halftime (of the Portland Trail Blazers game on Wednesday night) talking. When he makes a decision, that's up to him. That's why I hired him. I trust Joe, because I feel like he knows people. He's known Willie since he was a child, so they know each other. And if he can fix that problem, then he'll fix it. If he can't, then that'll be his decision, not mine. I've left that in his hands.”

Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars, Willie Green, Nov 14, 2025. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Willie Green
item.description:
“I wasn't here. All I can do is move forward and guide and create and lead and put expectations on what we need to do here to be successful. And only then can I judge Willie or anyone else. I was pleased with what I heard. I'm looking forward to going forward and working with Willie and to push us to success. You've got to set the bar. And that's what we're going to do.”

Joe Dumars on Willie Green, Jun 4, 2025. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Willie Green
item.description:
Dumars spent much of his first few weeks on the job talking to people in the building to help with his assessment of the Pelicans' coaching staff and players.

“It's hard for me to come in here and say 'here's how I assessed Willie (Green) last year,'”

Joe Dumars on Willie Green, Jun 4, 2025. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Willie Green
item.description:
So it’s Green’s voice that resonates the most in this locker room.

“Willie’s got great leadership qualities and we respect him as a coach. But really, we respect who he is as a person more than anything,”

Trey Murphy on Willie Green, Apr 12, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Willie Green
item.description:
Zion on the All-Star nod:

“I want to thank Coach Green. The Pelicans organization. My teammates. Especially T-Spoon and Brew. Those two really helped me a lot the past two years. Without that group of people, I wouldn’t be in this situation.”

Zion Williamson on Willie Green, Jan 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: David Griffin on Willie Green
item.description:
“I saw him be utterly moved by Willie Green and his staff and this team quite frankly during that playoff run. So we feel really confident he wants to be here and we feel equally confident we can come to an agreement.”

David Griffin on Willie Green, Jun 9, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Antonio Daniels on Stephen A. Smith, Willie Green, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Antonio Daniels:

“What you have here in New Orleans is, a lot was going on early on in the season, new pieces trying to fit in along with head coach Willie Green. And that's a lot to take on early; 1-12, 3-16 is what this team started. And now, at that time, the talk was, 'Let's tank. There's no Zion.' Fans all said they should just tank the season. Even when you acquired CJ McCollum. I remember Stephen A. Smith saying, 'Oh, I don't know what they're doing. Why would CJ McCollum want to go there? New Orleans ain't going anywhere anyway.’”

Antonio Daniels on Stephen A. Smith, Willie Green, CJ McCollum, Apr 28, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Chris Paul on Willie Green
item.description:
Paul told The Times-Picayune.

“I root so hard for Willie, for the city. When Willie got the job there, I probably had to be the happiest person. Because not only did he deserve a head coaching job, but the city of New Orleans deserved someone like him.”

Chris Paul on Willie Green, Apr 22, 2022. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Devin Booker on Willie Green
item.description:
Kellan Olson:Devin Booker on the job Willie Green has done in New Orleans:

“Setting a foundation and developing a culture over there, you can see the camaraderie between those guys that they believe in him. That's really important if you're trying to win basketball games.”

Devin Booker on Willie Green, Apr 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Willie Green
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Ty Lue on #Pelicans:

“My biggest thing is just the job Willie Green has done this year. They started 3-16, but have been 31-27 since then. Getting his team to believe, staying the course. I'm really happy for Willie and how they persevered and got to this point.”

Tyronn Lue on Willie Green, Apr 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Devonte Graham on Willie Green
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Devonte' Graham on Willie Green's message to #Pelicans to maintain a positive mentality:

“Keep your integrity. Don’t start pointing fingers. Keep fighting... You can’t give up your teammates. You can’t give up on the organization. It’s going to turn. It’s going to get better.”

Devonte Graham on Willie Green, Nov 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Willie Green
item.description:
Christian Clark:Steve Kerr on Willie Green:

“When you’re around him and you feel his ease, his confidence, his measured way, it didn’t take long to think, ‘Yeah, he’s going to be a head coach.'”

Steve Kerr on Willie Green, Nov 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Jaxson Hayes on Willie Green
item.description:
Eliot Clough:Jaxson Hayes on Willie Green:

“I feel like Coach Green clicks better with our team. He's a former player so he knows what we go through.”

Jaxson Hayes on Willie Green, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: Josh Hart on Willie Green
item.description:
Eliot Clough:Josh Hart on coming back to the Pelicans:

“I was excited. I think we're building the right culture with the addition of Willie.”

Josh Hart on Willie Green, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Willie Green
item.description:
Eliot Clough:Zion on his relationship with Willie Green:

“He's a straightforward guy. There's not much beating around the bush. He does what needs to be done. I respect a guy like that.”

Zion Williamson on Willie Green, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: David Griffin on Willie Green
item.description:
David Griffin on the Willie Green hire:

“Willie has established himself as one of the most respected assistant coaches in the NBA. In large part, this is due to a tireless work ethic and authenticity of character.”

David Griffin on Willie Green, Jul 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark3000.

item.title: Devin Booker on Willie Green
item.description:
Suns guard Devin Booker on Willie Green joining Pelicans:

“I respect him to the fullest. New Orleans is going to have a really good guy on their hands that’s taking control and leading that group. Obviously, it’s always tough to lose somebody like that out of the organization.”

Devin Booker on Willie Green, Jul 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Devin Booker on Willie Green
item.description:
Devin Booker on Willie Green becoming the HC in New Orleans:

“We’ve been through a lot these last two years ... spending a lot of time together. We’ve developed a relationship, and I respect him to the fullest. New Orleans is going to get a really good guy on their hands.”

Devin Booker on Willie Green, Jul 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark3000.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Willie Green
item.description:
“Just had some personalities that didn’t get along. But the one guy that the whole group did listen to was Willie. He wasn’t the best player. As a matter of fact, he wasn’t even playing much by then. But he had a way about himself.”

Doc Rivers on Willie Green, Jul 15, 2021. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Chris Paul on Willie Green
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Chris Paul on what kind of head coach Willie Green will be:

“I'm a little biased, that's my guy right there...not just my teammate, that's a brother to me. I know he deserves it. He'll be the most humble, prepared coach you've ever seen in your life.”

Chris Paul on Willie Green, Jul 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Moe Harkless on Willie Green
item.description:
“Willie's definitely somebody that I talk to whenever I get frustrated. He's the one to talk to. It's always Willie.”

Moe Harkless on Willie Green, May 6, 2015. Source: Orlando Sentinel.
